description.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム 0083 スターダストメモリー」に登場するMS "パワードジム"がHGUCシリーズに登場。全身、極力合わせ目が目立たないパーツ構成で見た目のスマート感を追求。肘には二重関節を採用し、可動範囲が拡大。手首は、ライフル/バズーカ兼用右手首、サーベル用右手首、手首に可動軸が追加されたバズーカ添え手用左手首の３種が付属。ブルバップ・マシンガン、シールド、ビームサーベル、ハイパーバズーカが付属。
description.en: The MS "Powered Jim " that appears in " Mobile Suit Gundam 0083 Stardust Memory" is now available in the HGUC series. Pursuing a smart appearance with parts that make the seams as inconspicuous as possible throughout the body. The elbows have double joints, increasing the range of motion. Three types of wrists are included: a right wrist for rifle/bazooka, a right wrist for saber, and a left wrist for bazooka with a movable axis added to the wrist. Includes bullbop machine gun, seal, beam saber, and hyper bazooka.
